author: battousai_hades

gamefaqs.product: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask

format: Wii data.bin (an SD-card export; header AES-128-CBC with the SD key, header MD5 valid): title 00010001-NARP "Zelda: Majora's Mask", 1 file: EEP_NZSP 262144 bytes - EEP_NZSP is the N64 cartridge save in console byte order

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/wiivc-convert.py convert the-legend-of-zelda-majoras-mask.26519.bin OUT: decrypts the data.bin (AES-128-CBC, SD key, per-file IVs) and takes EEP_NZSP (262144 bytes, FlashRAM): first 0x20000 bytes, 32-bit words reversed, at 0x28800

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

rom.name: Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es) (Rev 1).z64

verified.script: scripts/n64/Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask.load.txt
verified.baseline: with no save the PAL game first asks for a language, then shows two empty files

mupen64plus-next.detail: "¿Abro este fichero?" Fichero 1 "Link": 20 hearts, MÁSCARAS 24, the four transformation masks (the save's language is Spanish)

parallel-n64.detail: Fichero 1 "Link": 20 hearts, 24 masks, the four transformation masks

mupen64plus.detail: "Por favor, elige un fichero": Fichero 1 "Link" (with no save the game asks for a language and a name)

note: The VC keeps Majora's Mask's FlashRAM as a 256 KiB file: the first 128 KiB is the flash (unused pages filled with AA, the VC's fill, not FF), the second half is all AA. The converter keeps the first 128 KiB (save-file-converter keeps all 256 KiB as the .fla). Verified with the European Rev 1 (the library's only European release); the VC's game code is NZSP.
